hero.subheadline: A self service music machine for modern bars. Guests choose songs, pay directly on the machine. 25,000+ tracks. Zero hassle.

choose.title: Choose a Song
choose.desc: Browse 25,000+ tracks on the touchscreen. Karaoke or music — your choice.

pay.title: Pay Directly
pay.desc: Tap to pay. No app, no account, no staff needed. Just music.

play.title: It Plays
play.desc: Your song queues up instantly. The crowd sings along.

atmosphere.quote: Our guests stay later and spend more. SVANDA basically runs itself.

revenue.title: New Revenue Stream
revenue.desc: Every song played earns you money. Guests pay directly at 10 CZK per song.

noStaff.title: Zero Staff Needed
noStaff.desc: The machine handles song selection, payments, queuing, and playback.

catalogue.title: 25,000+ Songs
catalogue.desc: From classics to chart toppers. Karaoke and jukebox in one box.

setup.title: Full Service Included
setup.desc: We install, maintain, and update. You just collect the earnings.

contact.subtitle: Fill in the form and we'll get back to you within one business day. We'll handle the full setup and you just enjoy the results.
contact.promise: We respond to every inquiry. If you're a bar or venue owner curious about SVANDA we want to hear from you.
